notes.title: New Lower Price and Week Long Sale
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25050674/35022b3faa9d7ee26825a865ea802f918c8028dc.png[/img]

MechoEcho celebrates two years on Steam with a new lower price and a week long sale!

Thanks to all the amazing players who have enjoyed MechoEcho and made fantastic creations with my game! In creating MechoEcho, I created the game I always wanted to play. I'm grateful to be able to share with so many fans of puzzle and construction games. Thank you!

To celebrate MechoEcho's second anniversary on Steam we are reducing the price. We are also offering the game for a special ultra low price this week only. If it's on your wish list, buy it now! Buy it for your friends! It's never going to be this low again!

notes.title: FREE EXPANSION – 10 New Super Tough Levels!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25050674/35022b3faa9d7ee26825a865ea802f918c8028dc.png[/img]

Here it is! MechoEcho v1.1. You challenged me to add more content with increased difficulty. I worked all month since the release to give you what you asked for. So now I'm challenging you to solve 10 new levels with new mechanics such as zero gravity and frictionless surfaces! 

With the 30 original levels, the game now has a total of 40 levels plus Sandbox. Be warned! The difficulty in the new levels has gone way up so expect multiple obstacles in the same level and increased challenges.

This new campaign also provides backstory and plot twists. You’ll play as Echo’s lab partner who surreptitiously followed her into MECHO. Find out what happens from a whole new perspective.

Along with some additional fixes for all players, I have also introduced keyboard support for left-handed players who can now remap keys to the numeric keypad.

You can play the new levels immediately, whether or not you have finished the main campaign. I’ve been listening to your feedback and here is the result. Let me know what you think!
